CFML Language Reference: Functions

ListChangeDelims

Returns a list with every delimiter between elements replaced by a new delimiter. The new delimiter can be any string, even several characters long or empty.

Category

List functions

Syntax

ListChangeDelims(list, new_delimiter [, delimiters ])

Parameters

list
The list to convert.
new_delimiter
The string to put between the elements.
delimiters
Optional. The delimiter characters the list uses now; the default is a comma.

Returns

The list with its new delimiters.

Usage

Empty elements are dropped along the way, so ListChangeDelims is also a handy way to clean up a list like "a,,b,". To turn a list into an HTML list or table row, use an HTML tag as the new delimiter, as the example does.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Browsers = "Netscape 4.7,Internet Explorer 5,,Mosaic,Lynx">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Original: #Browsers#</P>
<P>Slashes: #ListChangeDelims(Browsers, " / ")#</P>
<P>As a bulleted list:</P>
<UL><LI>#ListChangeDelims(Browsers, "<LI>")#</UL>
<P>As a table row:</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3><TR><TD>#ListChangeDelims(Browsers, "</TD><TD>")#</TD></TR></TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
